an4.121:2.3: ahañceva kho pana kāyena duccaritaṃ careyyaṃ vācāya duccaritaṃ careyyaṃ manasā duccaritaṃ careyyaṃ kiñca maṃ attā sīlato na upavadeyyāti
an4.121:2.4: so attānuvādabhayassa bhīto kāyaduccaritaṃ pahāya kāyasucaritaṃ bhāveti vacīduccaritaṃ pahāya vacīsucaritaṃ bhāveti manoduccaritaṃ pahāya manosucaritaṃ bhāveti suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati
an4.121:3.3: ahañceva kho pana kāyena duccaritaṃ careyyaṃ vācāya duccaritaṃ careyyaṃ manasā duccaritaṃ careyyaṃ kiñca maṃ pare sīlato na upavadeyyunti
an4.121:3.4: so parānuvādabhayassa bhīto kāyaduccaritaṃ pahāya kāyasucaritaṃ bhāveti vacīduccaritaṃ pahāya vacīsucaritaṃ bhāveti manoduccaritaṃ pahāya manosucaritaṃ bhāveti suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati
an4.121:4.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco passati coraṃ āgucāriṃ rājāno gahetvā vividhā kammakāraṇā karonte
an4.121:4.3: kasāhipi tāḷente vettehipi tāḷente aḍḍhadaṇḍakehipi tāḷente hatthampi chindante pādampi chindante hatthapādampi chindante kaṇṇampi chindante nāsampi chindante kaṇṇanāsampi chindante bisaṅgathālikampi karonte saṃkhamuṇḍikampi karonte rāhumukhampi karonte jotimālikampi karonte hatthappajjotikampi karonte erakavaṭṭikampi karonte cirakavāsikampi karonte eṇeyyakampi karonte balisamaṃsikampi karonte kahāpaṇakampi karonte khārāpaṭicchakampi karonte palighaparivattakampi karonte palālapiṭhakampi karonte tattenapi telena osiñcante sunakhehipi khādāpente jīvantampi sūle uttāsente asināpi sīsaṃ chindante
an4.121:5.2: yathārūpānaṃ kho pāpakānaṃ kammānaṃ hetu coraṃ āgucāriṃ rājāno gahetvā vividhā kammakāraṇā karonti kasāhipi tāḷenti …pe… asināpi sīsaṃ chindanti ahañceva kho pana evarūpaṃ pāpakammaṃ kareyyaṃ mampi rājāno gahetvā evarūpā vividhā kammakāraṇā kareyyuṃ kasāhipi tāḷeyyuṃ …pe…
an4.121:5.4: so daṇḍabhayassa bhīto na paresaṃ pābhaṭaṃ palumpanto carati
an4.121:6.3: kāyaduccaritassa kho pāpako vipāko abhisamparāyaṃ vacīduccaritassa pāpako vipāko abhisamparāyaṃ manoduccaritassa pāpako vipāko abhisamparāyaṃ
an4.121:6.4: ahañceva kho pana kāyena duccaritaṃ careyyaṃ vācāya duccaritaṃ careyyaṃ manasā duccaritaṃ careyyaṃ kiñca taṃ yenāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjeyyanti
an4.121:6.5: so duggatibhayassa bhīto kāyaduccaritaṃ pahāya kāyasucaritaṃ bhāveti vacīduccaritaṃ pahāya vacīsucaritaṃ bhāveti manoduccaritaṃ pahāya manosucaritaṃ bhāveti suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati
